name: @mark1russell7/optional
description: The Optional of the family: a value that is present (some) or absent (none), for render and Vex.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @optional/site run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint:ste

no-build-output.off: Git keeps dist/, because render and Vex install this package from git, and a git dependency needs no build at install. CI checks that dist/ is the build of src/.

typed-scripts.reason: dist/ is the build output of src/, which is TypeScript.
